verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a free tier for cubic that is unlocked by signing in with a personal account. The closest item, connecting an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription for local CLI reviews, avoids API keys but uses a paid third-party subscription rather than giving free-tier access. The other pricing evidence covers included capacity, flex spend limits and Pro/Max gating, none of which shows a free personal tier.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys
